page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-48 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 48 vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled, providing two threads per core. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of dedicated system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng and PassMark CPU tests placing the instance in the top 25% of evaluated systems. It demonstrates average performance in memory bandwidth, with read-only small block cached memory operations reaching 3051.54 GB/sec and uncached large block writes at 57.35 GB/sec. Cryptographic and physics simulations perform strongly, as evidenced by a PassMark encryption score of 51408.75 and a physics score of 6104.64.

The instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads such as software compilation, image processing, and ray tracing, which align with its strong multi-core benchmark results. It also supports moderate database operations and text processing, though memory bandwidth remains within average parameters. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into the overall resource architecture.
